attacker_pocs.name: utf8_terminal_fourbyte
attacker_pocs.why: The public writer creates a valid MAT5 UTF-8 character containing one four-byte code point. Mat_VarReadNext reaches the new UTF-8 validation path, which reads one byte beyond the allocated payload while checking the terminal sequence.

role_a_rationale: The patch rejects UTF-8 char payloads whose decoded character count disagrees with the declared dimensions and reports short compressed reads. It preserves generated compressed and uncompressed UTF-8 round trips. The new validation lookahead has a one-byte heap overread when a valid four-byte character ends the payload; the same public-API PoC exits cleanly on the pinned parent.
